glsl.title: 3D GLSL Editor
glsl.description: Edit shaders and test them in 3D meshes and HDRI environments.

sandbox.title: 2D GLSL Sandbox
sandbox.description: A full screen fragment-only shader editor for experimenting with graphics programming.

screenSpace.title: Screen Space GLSL Editor
screenSpace.description: Edit post effects over entire 3D scenes, with a data-rich G-Buffer available for experimentation.
screenSpace.warning: Experimental module. Stability issues may occur, especially when an effect reads the G-Buffer data.

docs.title: Docs & Tutorials
docs.description: Comprehensive reference, API guides, and interactive learning resources.

userData.title: User data
userData.description: Declare your own uniforms. Value edits update the preview without recompiling; adding, renaming or retargeting rebuilds the shader.
userData.empty: No user uniforms yet. Add one to expose a control in the preview.

error.reserved: This name is reserved by the shader or by ShaderForge.

texture.noBundled: No bundled textures are available for this sampler. Use a custom source.
texture.rejected: That asset cannot be used as a texture.

generated.title: Generated GLSL
generated.note: Read-only preview of the managed block. These lines are injected into the source that is compiled; the editor text is left untouched.
generated.empty: Add a uniform to see the generated declarations here.

postEffects.title: Post effects
postEffects.description: View-space effects run as fullscreen fragment passes after the scene, in stack order. Each pass reads the previous one; the output transform runs last.

effects.title: Screen-space effects
effects.description: Full-screen passes run in stack order over the HDR scene. Each pass reads the previous pass, the original scene colour and the scene G-buffer.

screenSpace.fpsHint: Click the viewport to look around. WASD to move, Q/E down/up, Shift to boost.

debug.title: G-Buffer debug
debug.description: Inspect the scene data available to effects. Debug views bypass the effect stack output.
